title: init's answers, the file init.mjs --answers reads
description: The handful of answers a new country repository is generated from, given at init's questions or in a file. country, name, organisation, timeZone, map.lat, map.lon and owners are required; every other answer is optional and its standard default is in its description. An unknown answer fails. The kit's reader (country-kit/lib/answers.mjs) adds the rules a schema cannot say: English is not among the languages, a producer code that belongs to another authority, the time zone's two checks, the refused domain and series ids, the short format's tokens and the map's ranges.

country.description: Required. The country's ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, two letters a-z: niord-<country>, org.niord.<country>, niord_<country>. Choose it once.

name.description: Required. The country's name, plain text, at most 60 characters: the manifest's name and the root README.

organisation.description: Required. The authority that runs the deployment, plain text, at most 100 characters: the settings file's organisation.

languages.description: Optional; standard default [] (English only). The languages besides English, each a published pack pinned from its home, applied as UI and content language of both applications. English is always there and is not listed.

producerCode.description: Optional; standard default '' (none yet). The IHO S-62 producer code, four upper-case letters or digits, written to application.yml as niord.s124.producer-code. Another authority's code and the guide's placeholder are refused.

timeZone.description: Required. The IANA time zone of the first domain and the public site, spelt as the tz database spells it: Intl must take it, and it must have the case-sensitive shape (UTC, or Area/Location with capitals), since Java reads a spelling it does not know as GMT. The spelling given is written.

map.description: Required. The map's default centre and zoom: the settings file's mapDefault* and the first domain's.

lat.description: Required. The latitude, whole degrees from -90 to 90.

lon.description: Required. The longitude, whole degrees from -180 to 180.

zoom.description: Optional; standard default 6. The zoom level, a whole number from 1 to 18.

domain.description: Optional; each part has its standard default. The first domain, written to be/bootstrap/domains.json.

id.description: Optional; standard default <country>-nw (<country>-nm for an NM domain). Lower-case letters, digits and '-', starting with a letter, 2 to 63 characters; not niord-client-master, nor a Keycloak built-in or shared client id.

name.description: Optional; standard default '<name> Navigational Warnings' ('<name> Notices to Mariners' for an NM domain). Plain text, at most 100 characters.

mainType.description: Optional; standard default NW. NW for navigational warnings, NM for notices to mariners; the first series has the same.

series.description: Optional; each part has its standard default. The first domain's one message series.

id.description: Optional; standard default <country>-nw (<country>-nm for an NM domain). The domain id's rule.

shortFormat.description: Optional; standard default <COUNTRY>-NW-${number-3-digits}-${year-2-digits} (-NM- for an NM domain). Plain text with the backend's tokens only, a number token among them unless numberSequenceType is NONE.

owners.description: Required. The repository's owners for .github/CODEOWNERS, one or more, each a GitHub @user or @org/team.

defaultLanguage.description: Not an answer: the default language is English. Tolerated as en only; another default language is the country guide's in-depth recipe.
